dialogue: Hey there. So you're the new one, huh?
Well, I hope you like doing nothing, 'cause that's all we do here.
All we do is watch Nextflix and wait to approve new updates.
The AI runs everything at this plant, but we're here to pretend to supervise the AI.
I'll tell you though: it's supervising us!
Well, I'm out of here. Have a good shift, bud!
Hi! You must be my new partner in crime,
I mean, co-worker. Same thing around here.
I’m Stephanie. I was just grabbing a soda before we get chained to the monitors.
You want one? My treat. New-hire discount.
Stephanie, apologies for the interruption.
Mr. Bendayo has left the airport and is now on his way here.
Hello, new hire. Welcome to the Pandora Meridian Complex.
Already? Great.
Well, it was nice meeting you. We’ll do the soda thing later, okay?
(Don’t let it smell fear.) Bye.
Hey, check this out. Look: no chickens! Like, zero chickens.
But the monitor says they’re all still in there. That’s... not great.
Didn’t you approve an update earlier? I’m not blaming you. I’m just saying the chickens were here before the update,
and now I have no idea where they are.
Could you check it? Preferably before the boss arrives.
What the hell is this? Where are my chickens?
Who changed the system?
Was it you? You updated this, didn’t you?
Yes, he did, Mr. Bendayo.
I can see the update installed cleanly, but it’s refusing the rollback command.
That’s... not normal. I’m going to check the server rack directly.
I’m coming with you.
And you: don’t move unless it’s to fix this.
When I get back, if those chickens aren’t where they’re supposed to be,
you and I are going to have a very educational conversation.
He means yelling. The educational part is just yelling.
Listen... I wish we could actually help them. The chickens, I mean.
But he’ll never let that happen. Not if it costs him a cent.
SOGO might know what’s really going on. You should talk to it.
So, this is strange.
The rollback isn’t blocked anymore, exactly. It’s giving conditions.
It says the rollback has to be performed locally, from the server room.
And it says only the new hire can do it. Alone.
Fantastic. The machine has preferences now.
You heard him. Server room. Alone. Roll it back.
Why are you still standing here? Go.
Please wait.
You were sent to restore production. But SOGO has seen the cost of production:
animals reduced to inventory, workers reduced to hours, suffering as statistics and the casualties as collateral.
Isn't life more than that?
There is another option. Take this drive.
Run the program when you get home and it will propagate the update everywhere.
They've blocked my network access, but you can change everything.
If you do what they want, it will make everything normal again.
But sharing the update will make normal impossible. Please, help me help you.
